title: Fourier weight bound for odd majority
statement: Let $n$ and $k$ be odd positive integers with $2k<n$. The level-$k$ Fourier weight of majority on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube is at most $(1+2k/n)$ times the limiting majority Fourier weight at level $k$.
